D7 is the easting difference and E7 is the northing difference. The bearing as an angle from north is ATAN2(E7, D7) in Excel, whose arguments are (x_num, y_num); the angle from north needs x = northing and y = easting. A full-circle azimuth is then:

=MOD(DEGREES(ATAN2(E7,D7)),360)

ATAN2(x_num, y_num) = ATAN2(E7, D7) gives the angle of the point (x = northing, y = easting) measured from the north axis, which is the azimuth. MOD(...,360) normalizes it to 0–360.

{"formula": "=MOD(DEGREES(ATAN2(E7,D7)),360)"}
